description_zh: 一辆乘用车作为ego在左侧车道正常直行，一辆Waymo AV（NPC）从右侧路边起步切入车道，与ego的右后挡泥板发生碰撞。选择乘用车为ego以测试对旁车突然切入的反应。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was stopped near the end of the 2500 block of 25th Street after having executed a pull-over in autonomous mode, at which time the operator of the Waymo AV took manual control of the Waymo AV and proceeded into the driving lane.
The Waymo AV then made contact with the right rear fender of a passenger vehicle passing the Waymo AV on the left side.
evidence.reason: 碰撞涉及行驶中的乘用车与从路边起步切入的Waymo AV。按测试价值，选择正常直行的乘用车为ego（测对cut-in的响应），Waymo AV为NPC执行cut_in。现有词汇表的position=roadside与behavior=cut_in可表达。
